{{Top|leg}}
'''Tarlen Ten''', [[trade master]] of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]. Ten accepted bribes from the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] [[defiler]]s in exchange for information on fleet movements in Cardia and nearby systems. Ten also insured that local garrisons on Cardia's surface did not respond to the operations of Consortium personnel.<ref name="FoC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]'' Mouse-over description of Bribery for the planet Carida.</ref>
